name: race_rival_view_toggle
description: In a race the camera starts over my hollow (design 5.7, contract-m6.md §5). Played as the game plays it: Tide Race on the hub, Race the caretaker, and the match scene builds both hollows from its start (the first build, not a rebuild). V jumps to the rival's hollow, keeping the same view of it, and V again back; Home frames my whole hollow from wherever the camera looks; the minimap shows both hollows, the rival's veiled and mine bright. A seat of the second team starts over the second hollow and V shows the first. With one hollow V does nothing.

steps.msg: Tide Race alone offline: Race the caretaker

steps.assert: Game.sim.race and Game.sim.mode == 'tide_race' and Game.my_hollow() == 0 and Game.rival_hollow() == 1
steps.msg: a race, my seat on the first hollow

steps.assert: scene.hollows_shown() == 2 and scene.board.width == 50 and count('landmarks') == 4 and node('Minimap').hollows == 2
steps.msg: both hollows stand from the start
the camera starts over my hollow

steps.assert: my_welling.x > 280 and my_welling.x < 1250 and my_welling.y > 80 and my_welling.y < 564
steps.msg: my Welling stands on screen as in a match of one
V shows the rival's hollow, the same view of it
V again comes back to mine

steps.assert: scene.camera.viewing() == 0 and absf(scene.camera.focus.x - 12.0) < 0.001 and absf(scene.camera.focus.z - 9.9) < 0.001 and absf(scene.camera.distance - 21.0) < 0.001
steps.msg: Home frames my whole hollow, wherever the camera looked
its Welling and Holdfast in view
the minimap shows both hollows, the rival's veiled, mine bright

steps.assert: Game.my_hollow() == 1 and Game.rival_hollow() == 0 and scene.camera.viewing() == 1 and absf(scene.camera.focus.x - 37.5) < 0.001 and node('Minimap').dimmed() == [0]
steps.msg: a seat of the second team: the camera over the second hollow, the first veiled
V shows the first, its rival's

steps.assert: scene.hollows_shown() == 1 and scene.camera.viewing() == 0 and absf(scene.camera.focus.x - 11.5) < 0.001 and node('Minimap').dimmed() == []
steps.msg: back to one hollow: the camera over it and nothing veiled
with one hollow V does nothing
